verification.environment: Local; disposable PostgreSQL test schemas; broker stubs; live execution disabled
verification.scope: Existing workspace includes preserved pre-existing unrelated lockfile/test edits. Not a clean-room or connected-broker certification.

sections.name: Shared contracts
sections.gap: Owner isolation and CSRF exist; workspace roles, transactional outbox, complete route/filter/draft restoration, performance/failover evidence and operational sign-off remain open.

sections.name: Overview
sections.gap: Open-position P&L is not daily P&L; overnight baseline/fees policy and worker-derived running count are missing. Scope and stale-exposure safeguards have tests.

sections.name: Strategies
sections.gap: Saved research definitions are not immutable StrategyVersion records or deployments. Running/paused filters, leases, start/pause and revision-safe editing remain unimplemented.

sections.name: Strategy library
sections.gap: Three implemented daily rules; no versioned shared strategy AST or durable promotion. Hilega/AI are explicitly unavailable, not certified features.

sections.name: Backtest studio
sections.gap: Broker daily history feeds local calculation; export records provider, exact query and hashes. Durable jobs/cancellation, provenance registry, sessions/intraday rules and corporate-action validation remain open.

sections.name: Algo lab
sections.gap: Current screen edits scheduled baskets, not the specified full MA/rule editor. Revision conflicts, idempotent saves, durable unsaved-change guard and AI validation remain open.

sections.name: Spread builder
sections.gap: Analytic same-expiry payoff exists. Canonical metadata-preserving draft versions and server-priced executable basket review are not wired through this screen; no real margin/repair certification.

sections.name: Paper trading
sections.gap: Separate transactional LIMIT/DAY ledger exists but is hidden in live mode. Frozen server previews, partial fills and replay-model versioning remain open; ICICI is outside user scope.

sections.name: Option chain
sections.gap: Master contracts and shared real-data feed exist. Snapshot/sequence-gap protocol, canonical durable drafts and metadata-revision revalidation require acceptance work.

sections.name: Orders & trades
sections.gap: App OMS history exists; complete broker-originated orders/fill ledger, date/account filters, revision-safe cancel UI, cursor pagination and complete server exports remain open.

sections.name: Broker connections
sections.gap: Kotak-only session-bound adapter exists. Masked persistent account identity, per-capability verification, cross-account reconnect and exposure-aware disconnect require acceptance work.

sections.name: Live positions
sections.gap: Single broker monitoring and guarded app OMS exist. All-authorized-account discovery, durable outage snapshots, frozen exit plans and non-atomic flatten progress remain open.

sections.name: Account & security
sections.gap: Real password/MFA/session services exist. Enrollment cancellation, action-scoped recent-auth proofs, recovery regeneration and device/last-active metadata remain open.

sections.name: Audit log
sections.gap: Legacy owner text events only; UI dedup/time ordering added. Structured immutable envelopes, outbox, authorized entity links, retention boundaries and full exports remain open.

scope: Review of all numbered requirements; evidence is deliberately conservative. Automated model pass is not broker certification or screen-wide acceptance. Shared prose, journey and visual sign-offs remain in specification-audit.md.
